features.name: Default implementation for AL interfaces
features.description: AL interfaces can now have method bodies with default implementations, allowing existing implementations to continue working when new methods are added to an interface without requiring immediate changes to all implementations.
features.status_evidence_quote: Business Central 29 is currently in public preview. So you might you make sure to validate the final behavior
caveats: Should only be used when there is a sensible fallback behavior for the new method
Should not be used simply to hide a requirement
Default should be treated as a migration mechanism rather than a permanent solution

features.name: Required pending attribute for AL interface methods
features.description: A new attribute that can be added to interface methods to signal that implementations should eventually provide their own implementation, with a specified deadline and reason. Provides a migration period instead of forcing immediate changes.
features.status_evidence_quote: Business Central 29 is currently in public preview. So you might you make sure to validate the final behavior
caveats: Requires specifying a version deadline before which the method must be implemented
